sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines equipment inspection I1, to be preformed on an 
annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Nabel Mostafa, reviewed by eng. 
 Hasan Alsayed Abdel-Azez, and, approved 
 by eng. Abdel-Maged Abdel-Qawy Emara: Head Sector of 
 Sidi Kirir Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 Engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.

 safety category
Safety fence with caution works surrounding the work area is required

Electrical Isolation
Open the main motor breaker (1 NB 0115)
Switch off the DC supply
Open the motor space heater (1NHA12A-CCH-28)
افتح حوض زيت المحمل (1NHA21A-ECH-18)

sections.text: إجراءات

Correct leakages for 
cooling water flow as required, flush piping as needed,

Re-grease the 
cylinder grease 
until grease comes out

Clean the air filter motor by 
dry air.

Check visually the fan 
blades.

Change oil of the float 
bearing.

Change oil of fixed 
bearing.

Purge old grease and 
re-grease I.V.C. of the actuator shaft bearing.

Purge old 
grease of air cylinder and re-grease.

Purge old grease of 
flexible coupling drive end motor and re-grease.

Change 
oil of drive end motor.

Check 
visually the rotor, blade liners.

Check visually-adjust if needed 
the damper blades, linkage.

تحقق بصريا من المدخل 
إزالة المخروط وضبط إذا لزم الأمر.

Change oil the non-drive 
end motor.

Check visually the rotor 
body bound bolts and adjust if needed.

Tighten annually the 
foundation bolts, support steel.

Check 
visually the shaft bearing seals, adjust and change if needed.

تحقق 
بصريا السكن، وصندوق المدخل وضبط إذا لزم الأمر.
